Seed Germination Lab
Section: Question and controls
Question: does light change germination in this classroom trial?
Each group has 20 seeds of the same variety. Water volume, temperature and observation time are held constant.
Section: Observed counts after five days
Group | Light condition | Germinated seeds
A | Light | 16 of 20
B | Dark | 12 of 20
Section: Interpretation limits
Group A had more germinated seeds in this trial. The trial was not replicated. The notes do not establish a universal causal effect or statistical significance.
